works.name: SkillWeaver: Web Agents can Self-Improve by Discovering and Honing Skills
works.reported_operation: 网页代理探索、练习并封装 API，复用新技能继续积累能力。
works.limit: 技能积累和任务迁移不等于技能发现过程效率持续上升。
works.separating_intervention: 禁止新技能参与后续探索，保留相同执行预算。
works.tasks_and_resources: WebArena 与真实网站，另报告向弱模型迁移。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Live-SWE-agent: Can Software Engineering Agents Self-Evolve on the Fly?
works.reported_operation: 代理在解决软件任务时修改自身运行 scaffold。
works.limit: 同任务内自改与跨任务继承是不同证据，不能从 solve rate 推出代际增长。
works.separating_intervention: 分别允许任务内修改和跨任务继承并计入所有调用。
works.tasks_and_resources: SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Pro；摘要未给持续代际对照。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Group-Evolving Agents: Open-Ended Self-Improvement via Experience Sharing
works.reported_operation: 智能体群共享不同进化分支的经验来指导后续结构修改。
works.limit: 同进化个体数不保证同算力；探索多样性的价值需与开销分开。
works.separating_intervention: 固定总资源，切断分支间经验共享而保留种群。
works.tasks_and_resources: SWE-bench Verified、Polyglot，报告跨模型迁移与错误修复。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Adaptive Auto-Harness: Sustained Self-Improvement for Agentic System Deployment on Open-Ended Task Streams
works.reported_operation: 任务流驱动持续构建不同 harness，并按任务路由及保留演化经验。
works.limit: 部分信号来自人类引导；路由收益不等于改进器变强。
works.separating_intervention: 分别固定构建、路由和人类引导，记录时间向前评估。
works.tasks_and_resources: 预测市场、安全竞赛、事件预测任务流；摘要未给统一完整成本。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents
works.reported_operation: 代理在持续交互中交替行动并修订持久技能、提示和记忆。
works.limit: 早期 GPP 人类参与与后续自动循环必须分开，游戏进度不直接代表通用研发能力。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结自修订但保留同一交互历史和资源上限。
works.tasks_and_resources: 具身长期任务/游戏；摘要报告 reset-free 流程，完整预算待核。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
works.reported_operation: 根据代理失败生成环境包装组件，保留原验证器并训练策略。
works.limit: 环境包装保留验证器是特定设计，不保证所有新任务忠实有效。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结环境生成器、交叉环境和策略版本并评估原任务。
works.tasks_and_resources: 四领域五基准；报告独立实例泛化与执行步数。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Agentic Discovery of Neural Architectures: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design
works.reported_operation: 研究代理设计计算原语和架构，并将候选扩展到较大模型训练。
works.limit: 发现目标模型架构不等于将目标用作下一代设计者。
works.separating_intervention: 把新旧目标作为研究代理，检验后续架构发现能力。
works.tasks_and_resources: 24 小时搜索，候选扩展至350M/1B/3B；有1B预训练结果。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
works.reported_operation: 隔离训练算法修改，用隐藏评估器重训提交代码。
works.limit: 它测研发能力而非运行多代 RSI，归一化分数仍依赖所选任务和参照。
works.separating_intervention: 比较算法更改与仅运行/超参优化，控制探索和重训预算。
works.tasks_and_resources: 10 冻结仓库；1 B300 搜索4小时，重训至12小时。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
works.reported_operation: 统一描述策略、评价、修改机制及评价基准是否属于可修改系统。
works.limit: 属于可重写组件不等于实际发生有效重写；表示统一不是经验泛化定律。
works.separating_intervention: 保持可编辑接口相同，只改变实际修改与后续复用。
works.tasks_and_resources: 形式框架，非大规模训练实验；已选读定义和边界。
works.reading_scope: Sections 3.1–3.2: formal components, modifier membership and externally grounded evaluation base.

works.name: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
works.reported_operation: 让代理从模糊目标自行选数据和更新方式，再用隐藏专家任务评价。
works.limit: 完成训练或编辑流程不等于提高能力；报告中增益稀疏且不稳定。
works.separating_intervention: 比较自定验证与外部目标的一致性，以及继续训练造成的退化。
works.tasks_and_resources: 六目标、520隐藏条目，支持权重与harness修改；预算待全文核查。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Large Language Model Agents Are Not Always Faithful Self-Evolvers
works.reported_operation: 干预原始和压缩经验，检查代理决策是否真正依赖积累经验。
works.limit: 对经验不敏感可来自已有知识或压缩丢失，不能一概判为无学习。
works.separating_intervention: 置换/删除经验并跨模型、环境比较行为变化。
works.tasks_and_resources: 四框架、13底座、九环境；原始摘要与实验范围已核。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: ShinkaEvolve: Towards Open-Ended And Sample-Efficient Program Evolution
works.reported_operation: 通过多样性、父代选择与模型组合提高程序演化样本效率。
works.limit: 只有目标涉及 AI 训练/harness 时属直接 AI4AI；普通圆堆积不算自身进化。
works.separating_intervention: 分离目标程序收益和搜索器继承收益并计入所有候选。
works.tasks_and_resources: 包含 agent harness 与 MoE 损失发现，也有一般算法任务。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: CoVerRL: Breaking the Consensus Trap in Label-Free Reasoning via Generator-Verifier Co-Evolution
works.reported_operation: 同一模型交替学习生成与验证，以验证反馈过滤自一致错误。
works.limit: 多数投票仍提供噪声标签，摆脱部分共识错误不保证无锚点真理发现。
works.separating_intervention: 固定验证器并比较独立标签校准及生成多样性。
works.tasks_and_resources: Qwen/Llama 数学推理；标签自由训练中的共识陷阱。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Actor-Curator: Co-adaptive Curriculum Learning via Policy-Improvement Bandits for RL Post-Training
works.reported_operation: 神经课程选择器直接学习预计策略提升，适配非平稳题库采样。
works.limit: 课程控制器的学习不同于其自身更新算法被改进。
works.separating_intervention: 在相同题库/算力下冻结课程，并检验未见任务难度迁移。
works.tasks_and_resources: 推理后训练；bandit 目标与遗憾界，假设未完整审阅。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Agent-World: Scaling Real-World Environment Synthesis for Evolving General Agent Intelligence
works.reported_operation: 探索真实工具生态并生成可验证任务，按能力缺口持续训练。
works.limit: MCP 环境主题多不等于未见世界泛化，生成器和验证器来源需全文核查。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结环境库或能力缺口反馈，比较同预算迁移。
works.tasks_and_resources: 23个 agent 基准、8B/14B；预印本标注进行中。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: SkillOS: Learning Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
works.reported_operation: 用较晚关联任务的表现训练技能整理者，执行者保持冻结。
works.limit: 改善技能整理者是有价值的 AI4AI，但其更新流程未被自身改写。
works.separating_intervention: 共同目标下交叉整理者版本与执行者底座。
works.tasks_and_resources: 任务流中的延迟反馈，多轮 agent 与单轮推理；成本待核。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Socratic-SWE: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Trace-Derived Agent Skills
works.reported_operation: 从解题轨迹提取技能生成下一轮修复任务，执行验证后更新求解者。
works.limit: 梯度对齐作为学习价值代理需检验；软件领域闭环未推出通用科研提升。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结任务生成技能或反馈求解者，控制真实训练总成本。
works.tasks_and_resources: 四个 SWE/Terminal 基准；摘要报告三轮和相同算力对照。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
works.reported_operation: 在 Minecraft 中创建并复用可组合代码技能继续探索。
works.limit: 固定 GPT-4 与课程程序；技能复用不是已证元算法自改。
works.separating_intervention: 允许执行已获技能但禁止其影响后续技能发现。
works.tasks_and_resources: Minecraft 新世界迁移；黑盒模型，无参数微调。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: AgentEvolver: Towards Efficient Self-Evolving Agent System
works.reported_operation: 自提问、自导航与贡献归因让环境经验进入后续 agent 训练。
works.limit: 训练闭环的元过程仍有固定部分；高效率需全流程成本而非仅样本数。
works.separating_intervention: 分别冻结任务生成、经验引导和奖励归因。
works.tasks_and_resources: 多环境自主学习；原摘要为初步实验描述，完整算力待核。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: Teaching LLMs to Self-Evolve: Cultivating Core Meta-Skills with Reinforcement Learning
works.reported_operation: 用执行反馈训练多轮反思与修订能力，部署时进行演化搜索。
works.limit: 改进目标代码不等于目标本身是改进器；需实际闭环继承证据。
works.separating_intervention: 让训练前后模型改进相同未见程序，在同预算比较。
works.tasks_and_resources: 七编码基准及域外算法优化；初筛未提取总训练成本。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
works.reported_operation: 当前策略同时收集轨迹和提炼事后技能，技能诱导信号训练同一策略。
works.limit: 训练期事后信息在部署不可见；内化效果与信息泄漏边界需明确。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结分析者并去除事后技能通道，保持当前策略采样。
works.tasks_and_resources: 文本与视觉 agent 任务；联合结果 RL 和 token 级自蒸馏。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.

works.name: RL Tango: Reinforcing Generator and Verifier Together for Language Reasoning
works.reported_operation: 生成者与过程验证者交替用 RL 训练，外部结果正确性监督验证者。
works.limit: 不是完全无标签自证；固定结果验证构成外部锚点。
works.separating_intervention: 交叉冻结两方并测试不同难度和域外校准。
works.tasks_and_resources: 7B/8B，五数学及四域外任务，另测 ProcessBench。
works.reading_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
